title: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Prepositions used with the accusative case
Prepositions в, на, под and за are followed by the accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion:

items: Я купил книгу за два рубля.

blocks.text: From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 61.
Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Око за ___ (око, acc. sg.), зуб за зуб.
exercises.prompt: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.
exercises.why: **око → око** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**стол → стол** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Этот дом идёт под ___ (снос, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: This house is going to be demolished.
exercises.why: **снос → снос** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
**аренда → аренду** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**ответственность → ответственность** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like часть (A. sg. часть). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **мой → мою** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with ответственность). Declines like мой. Ending -я → -ю.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Гаишник за ___ (взятка, acc. sg.) согласился не отбирать водительские права.
exercises.prompt: For a bribe, a traffic policeman agreed not to take away a driver's license.
exercises.why: **взятка → взятку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том почувствовал себя так, будто его ударили под ___ (дых, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom felt like he had been punched in the gut.
exercises.why: **дых → дых** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Пастырь живет за ___ (счёт, acc. sg.) молитв, адвокат — законов.
exercises.prompt: A pastor lives via prayers, a lawyer via laws.
exercises.why: **счёт → счёт** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**брезент → брезент** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я предлагаю за ___ (этот натюрморт, acc. sg.) двести евро.
exercises.prompt: I'm offering two hundred euros for that still life.
exercises.why: **натюрморт → натюрморт** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **этот → этот** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with натюрморт). «этот» has its own declension (not the regular adjective pattern). Its forms (m. sg.): этот · этого · этому · этот (inan.) / этого (anim.) · этим · этом.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Слон взял коня, поставив под ___ (шах, acc. sg.) короля соперника.
exercises.prompt: The bishop took the knight, putting the opponent's king in check.
exercises.why: **шах → шах** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**выражение → выражение** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том взял меня под ___ (своё крылышко, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom took me under his wing.
exercises.why: **крылышко → крылышко** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **свой → своё** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with крылышко). Declines like мой. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том сильно постарел за ___ (последнее время, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom has aged a lot lately.
exercises.why: **время → время** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like имя (A. sg. имя). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **последний → последнее** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with время). Declines like синий (A. синее). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он даёт займы под ___ (высокий процент, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: He lends money at a high rate of interest.
exercises.why: **процент → процент** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **высокий → высокий** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with процент). Declines like русский (A. anim. = G., inan. = N). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Ислам и Коран приказывают отрубать руки за ___ (воровство, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Islam and the Quran order hands to be cut off for theft.
exercises.why: **воровство → воровство** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Инна легла под ___ (балдахин, acc. sg.) и крепко уснула.
exercises.prompt: Inna lay down under the canopy and fell fast asleep.
exercises.why: **балдахин → балдахин** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**исправление → исправление** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: "Под ___ (лежачий камень, acc. sg.) вода не течёт" — это пословица.
exercises.prompt: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.
exercises.why: **камень → камень** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like автомобиль (A. sg. автомобиль). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **лежачий → лежачий** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with камень). Declines like хороший (A. anim. = G., inan. = N). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
